crossRefs.note: “ ‘If by these things you won’t be turned back to me, but will walk contrary to me,
They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.
They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”
Wrath is not in me, but if I should find briers and thorns, I would do battle! I would march on them and I would burn…
but have lifted up yourself against the Lord of heaven; and they have brought the vessels of his house before you, and…
“Your words have been stout against me,” says Yahweh. “Yet you say, ‘What have we spoken against you?’
He said, “Who are you, Lord?” The Lord said, “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.
Now about that time, King Herod stretched out his hands to oppress some of the assembly.
Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.
God who is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who has hardened himself against him and prospered?
Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?
Pharaoh said, “Who is Yahweh, that I should listen to his voice to let Israel go? I don’t know Yahweh, and moreover I…
They said, “The God of the Hebrews has met with us. Please let us go three days’ journey into the wilderness, and…
because you still exalt yourself against my people, that you won’t let them go.
The Philistines were afraid, for they said, “God has come into the camp.” They said, “Woe to us! For there has not been…
Why then do you harden your hearts as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened their hearts? When he had worked wonderfully…
“Behold, this is the man who didn’t make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened…
Make an uproar, you peoples, and be broken in pieces! Listen, all you from far countries: dress for battle, and be…
Take counsel together, and it will be brought to nothing; speak the word, and it will not stand, for God is with us.”
Therefore it will happen that when the Lord has performed his whole work on Mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish…
Who has worked and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I, Yahweh, the first, and with the last, I am…

translations.web: Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,
translations.bsb: For he has stretched out his hand against God and has vaunted himself against the Almighty,
translations.kjv: For he stretcheth out his hand against God, and strengtheneth himself against the Almighty.
translations.asv: Because he hath stretched out his hand against God, And behaveth himself proudly against the Almighty;
